entries.reason: The logical connective between the three conditions 'result=pass / failureKind=null / nextAction=finalize-commit' is ambiguous. The '/' separator is used here without an explicit AND/OR operator, unlike the test-review/impl-review clause which uses 'かつ' to make AND explicit. A reviewer cannot determine from this phrasing whether all three conditions must hold simultaneously or whether satisfying any one is sufficient for normal completion.; 'FAIL artifact' is used in R4 ('FAIL artifact + done step で valid override evidence がない場合は inconsistent を返す') without definition. Two independent reviewers could disagree on whether this means an artifact whose verdict/result field literally equals 'FAIL'/'fail', or any artifact that fails to satisfy the step-specific normal completion conditions from R2 (e.g., impl-review with verdict=ADVISORY and blockingFindings>0 does not meet normal completion but its verdict is not 'FAIL'). The same undefined term recurs in the acceptance_criteria section.
